response.courseDescription: 484 Temporary Structures Temporary structures including formwork, falsework, soldier pile and lagging, sheet pile, cofferdam, scaffolding, underpinning, bracing and guying, air domes, and others.
response.coursePrerequisites: ARCH 352 with a C or better or CE 330 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or Architectural Studies.
